meta.label: Reference sites from an LLM-written CSV. Descriptive list, not scored results.
limits: Sites are places named as analogs in an LLM-written list. They are not scored results.
Coordinates come from an LLM-written CSV; many are approximate.
The CSV gave no source links, so none are shown.
Text about where the analogy breaks is LLM-written and has not been reviewed.
The v1 used flag is a coordinate match against the v1 site list, not a name match.
Earth sites differ from the Moon and Mars in gravity, air, radiation and dust; see the ledger.
meta.v1_used_rule: true: within the v1 site match radius of a v1 site run for the same body. unknown: near a v1 site but not matching, or v1 ran that site for the other body only. false: farther than the v1 exclusion distance from every v1 site.
